messages:
Sophia: Heads-up — dedicated canary (eu-west-1) after the 03:15 release is showing a sharp p95 jump for short-sequence requests (<64). Noticed around 03:20.
Raj: Seen it too, was debugging metrics dashboard. p95 ~120ms -> ~350ms for short seq paths.
Maria: Any deploy bot alerts? deploy-bot: [deploy] release/2026-03-18-03:15 rolled to dedicated-canary at 03:14:52 by ci/cd
Ethan: I pulled a flamegraph from canary node-3. CPU context-switch spikes align with the kernel selection path.
Sophia: Uploading snippet of profile
Sophia: ```
# excerpt
0.0s  runtime.kernel_selector.select_best
0.1s  runtime.kernel_selector.score_merge_candidates
0.2s  runtime.batching.assign_queue
```
Raj: That selector.score_merge_candidates call looks suspicious — we changed heuristics in PR 0f3a2b2 earlier today.
Maria: Which PR? 0f3a2b2 is the dynamic-kernel-hint merge that landed at 02:58.
Ethan: I can run local repro with a short-seq traffic replay.
Sophia: Replayed traffic against pre-merge build and post-merge build. Pre-merge p95 ~110ms, post-merge p95 ~360ms. Repro confirmed.
Raj: Starting bisect locally to confirm the exact commit. If it's the hinting change we might be misrouting short batches to the slow generic kernel.
Maria: Also seeing KV cache hit rate drop ~6% for short prefixes during the spike window.
Ethan: Interesting — if kernel selection delays cause longer scheduling windows then prefetch/pin for KV cache might miss.
oncall: Tagging @oncall — SLA alert: dedicated-canary p95 above canary-threshold for >10m. Please triage.
oncall: Current customer-visible latency: curated customers on dedicated are not yet impacted but risk exists if this reaches dedicated-prod.
Sophia: Plan suggestion: revert the kernel-hint commit from 02:58 in canary first, validate perf, then revisit heuristics.
Raj: Agree revert is fastest. I'll prepare a hot-revert PR that force-selects the previous kernel decision path for short sequences.
Maria: Can we also add a temporary override in routing policy: prefer kernel=A for seq<128 until fix? Might be less risky than full revert.
Ethan: If we can flip routing via runtime config, do that first — quicker rollback surface.
Raj: I tried flip via runtime toggle, but the toggle patch was part of same merge and the toggle key name changed -> not available. Revert looks required.
Sophia: Create revert PR, request CI perf job (short-seq smoke), then patch canary. We must be cautious — CI perf is flaky.
Ethan: I'll kick off a localized perf job using the canary perf harness and attach flamegraphs.
deploy-bot: [ci] triggered: perf/smoke-shortseq for ref revert/0f3a2b2-rollback by Raj
Maria: Also collecting KV cache traces to rule out separate regression: kv-trace logs uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/194220
Sophia: If revert fixes p95, we keep canary blocked from rolling to prod until we have a safe rework of the hinting logic.
Raj: Drafted revert PR: PR #4512 — reverts dynamic-kernel-hint commit 0f3a2b2. Pushed to branch revert/4512.
Sophia: Approving review, will merge once CI perf smoke green or we have manual confirmation on canary nodes.
oncall: Noted. If canary shows improvement, schedule a controlled promote window and notify sales/customer teams preemptively.
Ethan: Perf smoke passed on my local harness, merging to canary in 5.
Sophia: Merged. Observability: watching p95. Starting 03:48.
Raj: Early numbers look good — p95 back to ~115ms.
Maria: KV cache hit rate recovered in the same window.
oncall: Canary p95 under threshold for 12m and stable. Marking rollout blocker resolved for canary. Will keep monitoring for 2h.
Sophia: Follow-ups: (1) full bisect on hinting algorithm to find root cause, (2) add unit perf test for short-seq kernel routing, (3) ensure runtime toggle keys remain accessible in future merges.
Raj: Filing follow-up tickets and will pair with Maria on KV interactions.
Maria: I'll draft a short postmortem note for the release channel once we have the bisect result.
Ethan: Good catch team. :thumbsup:
Sophia: Thanks everyone. Keeping channel open for the 2h watch.
